units.source_text: 从此之后，信子更加温柔贤惠的照顾丈夫。

en.t: From then on, Nobuko cared for her husband even more gently and devotedly.

units.source_text: 丈夫察觉到，坐在中长火盆对面的妻子，略施粉黛的脸上洋溢着温柔的笑容，看起来比以前更加年轻漂亮。

en.t: Her husband noticed that his wife, seated across the long hibachi, had a gentle smile blooming on her lightly powdered face and looked younger and more beautiful than before.

units.source_text: 她边做针线活边谈论他们夫妻在京东举行婚礼的甜蜜往事。

en.t: As she sewed, she talked about the sweet memories of their wedding in Jingdong.

units.source_text: 没想到信子记得如此清晰，丈夫意料之外的开心。

en.t: Her husband had not expected Nobuko to remember so clearly, and he was unexpectedly pleased.
